notes: fw v0.1.2 — the zero-typing provisioning firmware: WiFi-only first-boot form, POST /provision, + all audit repairs + the TFT block protocol.

bug_fixes: THE DISPLAY: the build on your panel predated the corrected display-upload code (the 95% stall) - this build contains the complete per-block upload and the full authored interface (clock, date, relay cards with touch)
The panel reported the wrong version number (0.1.4) - every version field in the firmware now carries the true release version, verified byte-for-byte in the built binary before shipping
A WiFi or MQTT password containing a quote silently broke provisioning (the JSON escape was not undone) - fixed
features: The dashboard channel: the integration can now drive the panel's screen with custom dashboards (sanitized display commands + the dash page map)
